reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Training teachers and school administrators on education in emergencies (EIE).

description.narrative: 250 male and female teachers and educational supervisors have received training courses to be trainers in the targeted governorates. 15,000 teachers and volunteers working in the targeted schools received a training course to train and develop their abilities by the 250 who were trained in the project. 3450 male and female teachers received bags and teaching supplies for male and female official teachers and volunteers working in the targeted schools in 5 governorates and those affected by the emergency.
Improving the quality of learning and teaching in areas affected by armed conflict

The general objective: Contribute to ensuring the provision of quality education in emergencies by building and developing the capacities of 15,250 male and female teachers in schools, and providing evidence-based and high-quality education services to the community, providing methods and means that contribute to raising the efficiency of educational cadres in most schools in the districts rural and urban areas in the targeted governorates.
